title: MERRA-2 Monthly Aerosol Diagnostics (M2TMNXAER V5.12.4)
description: Monthly mean two-dimensional aerosol diagnostics from NASA's MERRA-2 reanalysis, including dust column and surface mass concentration and aerosol optical thickness at 550 nm, on a 0.625° × 0.5° grid.
purpose: A consistent long-term record of dust loading for studying sand and dust storm seasonality and its links with drought and land degradation over Algeria.

provider.name: NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC)

creator: Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO), NASA GSFC

license.name: NASA Earth science data — open, no restrictions on use (EOSDIS data use guidance)

citation: Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO) (2015), MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: 2d,Monthly mean,Time-averaged,Single-Level,Assimilation,Aerosol Diagnostics V5.12.4, Greenbelt, MD, USA, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), https://doi.org/10.5067/FH9A0MLJPC7N

references.citation: Gelaro, R., et al. (2017). The Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2). Journal of Climate, 30(14), 5419–5454.

spatial_extent.description: Global reanalysis grid. Algeria must be subset by the user.

variables.name: Dust surface mass concentration
variables.description: Surface mass concentration of dust aerosol

variables.name: Total aerosol extinction AOT 550 nm
variables.description: Total aerosol optical thickness at 550 nm

processing: Output of the GEOS-5 atmospheric model with assimilation of meteorological observations and of aerosol optical depth observations (MERRA-2 aerosol reanalysis).
limitations: Reanalysis output: values are model estimates constrained by assimilated observations, not direct measurements of dust or air quality.
Coarse grid (~50 km) cannot resolve local dust sources, urban pollution or terrain effects.
Dust emission over the Sahara is parameterised in the model and carries substantial uncertainty.

access.label: Access at source (GES DISC)
access.notes: NASA Earthdata Login required to download; subsetting services are available at the source.

algeria_notes: Captures the large-scale seasonal cycle of Saharan dust affecting southern and northern Algeria; not suitable for local air-quality assessment in cities.

verification.notes: Metadata from NASA CMR. Variable descriptions from the collection abstract; file variable names and units should be confirmed in the MERRA-2 file specification.
